office_does: The sheriff runs county law enforcement: patrol and emergency response across the county, criminal investigations, search and rescue, the jail and county emergency management.
race_blurb: Open seat: Sheriff Clay Myers is retiring. Chief Deputy Ben Kokjer, 21 years in the office, runs on reliable response, investigations and accountability. Darryl Chepoda Jr., an Upper County rancher and retired fire chief, runs on transparency, constitutional rights, community engagement and wildfire evacuation. Kokjer led the primary 78% to 22%.

candidates.summary: Chief Deputy of Operations at the Kittitas County Sheriff's Office, 21 years with the office, running on reliable response, investigations and accountability.
highlights: Deputy since 2005; operations commander from 2019, now chief deputy running patrol and major crimes [S2][S6][S7]
Promises a well-trained deputy shows up 'wherever in the county you live' [S1][S3]
Would hold offenders accountable while keeping body-worn cameras and protecting constitutional rights [S1]
Wants an Upper County Emergency Operations Center and a fully equipped West County Precinct [S1]

experience.basis: 21 years in the office, now its chief deputy running day-to-day operations, campaigning to 'build on our history'.

safety.basis: Enforcement-led platform (response coverage, investigations, holding offenders accountable), tempered by body cameras and constitutional-rights commitments.

reform.basis: Runs on continuity with the office shaped by the last two sheriffs.

candidates.summary: Fifth-generation Upper County rancher and retired fire chief, running as an independent on transparency, constitutional rights and community engagement.
highlights: Rancher and farmer; lists work as a retired fire chief, contractor and miner, and no law enforcement experience [S1]
Wants full and open transparency, constitutional rights and community engagement [S1]
Says wildfire evacuation needs renewed focus; floats an opt-in community information app [S1]

experience.basis: No law enforcement background in his statement; an outsider candidacy.

reform.basis: Says the office 'could better serve us' through transparency and community engagement, without specific changes.
